HEIF property interpretation (clean-room): field layouts per ISO/IEC 23008-12 (ispe, pixi, irot, imir, clap) and ISO/IEC 23001-17 (uncC, cmpd, cmpC). Values below were confirmed against bytes emitted by real-world writers (see tests/fixtures/heif/), never copied from code.

Imports

isobmff

Types

AuxType = object
  auxType*: string
CleanAperture = object
  wNum*, wDen*, hNum*, hDen*: int64
  hOffNum*, hOffDen*, vOffNum*, vOffDen*: int64
CmpEntry = object
  compType*: int
LayerSel = object
  layerId*: uint16
Mirror = object
  topBottom*: bool
  vertical*: bool
See 23008-12 §6.5.12.3: axis 0 exchanges top and bottom, axis 1 exchanges left and right. 
Nclx = object
  primaries*: int
  transfer*: int
  matrix*: int
  fullRange*: bool
PixelAspect = object
  hSpacing*, vSpacing*: uint32
PixInfo = object
  bits*: seq[int]
RelLoc = object
  hOff*, vOff*: uint32
Rotation = object
  quarterTurns*: int
Quarter-turns counter-clockwise (ispe-order application: after decode). 
ScaleInfo = object
  wNum*, wDen*, hNum*, hDen*: uint16
SpatialExtents = object
  width*, height*: int
UncProfile = object
  isV1*: bool
  v1Tag*: string
  bitDepth*: int
  sampling*: int
  interleave*: int
  tiled*: bool
  tileCols*: int             ## tile grid columns (clean-room "TL" profile only)
  tileRows*: int             ## tile grid rows (clean-room "TL" profile only)
Uncompressed frame description (23001-17). 
UserDesc = object
  lang*, name*, desc*, tags*: string

    uint8] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Clean-room "TL" tiled profile: v0 with tile-component interleave (4) and a 6-byte tail 'T','L', cols u16 BE, rows u16 BE. Sampling is 0 (tiling applies to full-resolution planes; subsampled YUV stays Unsupported). Readers must validate the tail strictly. 
proc buildUncCV0(depth: int; sampling, interleave: int;
                 compTypes: openArray[int]): seq[uint8] {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
v0 layout matching observed real-writer bytes (see parseUncC): FullBox + zero word + count + 5-byte entries 0, index, depth-1, 0, 0
  • sampling + interleave + zero word. No tail means untiled.

Clean-aperture crop in output pixels (23008-12 §6.5.5: centred offsets, offsets are (width-aperture)/2 style signed fractions).
